findings.message:
[P2] Update published API schema match-count bound

Changing `MAX_MATCH_COUNT` to 10,000 leaves the published request schema capped at 1,000 in `src/api_schema_catalog.ts:4523` and `public/openapi.json:86665`, and `deno task docs:check` will fail because the generated artifact differs. Update the catalog bound and regenerate the OpenAPI artifact so clients and the route agree on 0 through 10,000.

src/sales_nav_selector_repair_design.ts:94-94

summary: The route bound now matches the extension and the new parser and extension-origin HTTP tests cover 1,001 through 10,000, but the checked-in published API schema still advertises 1,000.

evidence: `src/sales_nav_selector_repair_design.ts:94` raises `MAX_MATCH_COUNT` to 10,000, so the parser accepts 1,001 through 10,000 while still rejecting 10,001 and invalid types.
`src/sales_nav_selector_repair_design_test.ts:43-57` adds the route-parser boundary test for accepted and rejected match counts.

`src/sales_nav_selector_repair_design_http_test.ts:71-109` exercises the extension-origin HTTP contract at 1,001 and 10,000 and confirms a chosen option still receives the server-owned element-present postcondition.
